## Page 1 — Cover Page

**Request for Proposal: Architectural and Engineering Design Services**

## Page 2 — Section A: Scope of Services

### A.1 Project Overview

The Synthetic Procurement Authority invites qualified consulting firms to
submit proposals for the architectural and engineering design of a new
8-storey commercial office building. The building will be constructed on
a 2,500 square metre site in the Synthetic Business District.

### A.2 Required Services

The selected consultant shall provide the following services:

1. Inception report and site assessment
2. Concept design (2 alternatives)
3. Detailed architectural design
4. Structural engineering design
5. MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) design
6. Construction supervision during implementation

### A.3 Deliverables

The following deliverables are required:

- D1: Inception Report (5 copies, hard + soft)
- D2: Concept Design Report (10 copies)
- D3: Detailed Design Drawings (15 copies)
- D4: Bill of Quantities (BOQ) in Excel format
- D5: Technical Specifications document
- D6: Construction Supervision Manual

---

## Page 3 — Section B: Mandatory Requirements

### B.1 Eligibility Requirements

- M1: The bidder must have a valid business license for engineering consultancy.
- M2: The bidder must have completed at least 3 similar building design projects in the last 5 years.
- M3: The bidder must have a minimum annual turnover of USD 500,000 for the last 3 fiscal years.
- M4: The bidder must be registered with the Synthetic Engineers Registration Board.

### B.2 Key Personnel Requirements

The bidder must propose the following key experts:

- Lead Architect with 10+ years of experience
- Senior Structural Engineer with 10+ years of experience
- MEP Engineer with 8+ years of experience
- Geotechnical Engineer with 5+ years of experience
- Project Manager with 10+ years of experience

### B.3 Submission Requirements

- Page limit: 50 pages for Technical Proposal
- Page limit: 20 pages for Financial Proposal
- Submission deadline: 2026-08-15 at 16:00 local time
- Submission address: SPA Office, Room 301, Synthetic Tower
- Submission method: Two-envelope system (Technical and Financial sealed separately)
- Bid bond: USD 10,000 (valid for 120 days)

---

## Page 4 — Section C: Evaluation Criteria

### C.1 Technical Evaluation (70 points)

| Criterion | Points |
|-----------|--------|
| Firm experience and track record | 15 |
| Key personnel qualifications | 20 |
| Technical approach and methodology | 20 |
| Work plan and timeline | 10 |
| Quality assurance plan | 5 |

### C.2 Financial Evaluation (30 points)

The financial proposal will be scored inversely — the lowest compliant
bid receives 30 points, and other bids receive a pro-rated score.

### C.3 Award Criteria

The contract will be awarded to the bidder with the highest combined
technical and financial score, provided the technical score is at least
70% of the maximum technical score (i.e., at least 49 out of 70 points).

---

## Page 5 — Section D: Terms of Reference

### D.1 Project Duration

The design phase is expected to take 6 months from contract signing.
Construction supervision is expected to take 18 months.

### D.2 Payment Schedule

- 10% on signing of contract
- 20% on approval of inception report
- 30% on approval of concept design
- 30% on approval of detailed design
- 10% on submission of final deliverables

### D.3 Validity of Proposal

Proposals must remain valid for 90 days from the submission deadline.
